text:
Priya: Quick sync on follow-ups from the postmortem  can we finalize the customer comms flow and redaction rules today?
Liam: I can finalize the status page copy and the short support note. Need Legal to confirm redaction items.
Hannah: Also want to make sure the action tracker has explicit owners and SLAs on each remediation. We had one item slip last time.
Legal: High level: public summary should be concise + non-technical. If a customer requests deeper detail, we provide a redacted RCA and a sanitized timeline after Legal review. No raw commands, internal hostnames, or staff IDs.
Priya: Good. Draft status page blurb: 
```
Customers in EU-Central experienced elevated error rates 2026-10-11 09:1509:47 UTC. Traffic was restored after reverting a configuration change. We apologize for the disruption. A follow-up incident summary and RCA will be published by 2026-10-14 17:00 UTC.
```
Liam: Can we swap `reverting a configuration change` to `a targeted configuration rollback`? Less specific and safer.
Legal: Agree with Liam. Also swap the commitment line to "we will publish an incident summary and RCA by 2026-10-14 17:00 UTC". Concrete datetime is better.
Hannah: Support note (short) suggestion: 
"We observed intermittent API errors affecting a subset of requests in EU-Central. The issue was mitigated and normal service restored. We will follow up with an incident summary and any customer impact analysis by 2026-10-14 17:00 UTC."
CS-Team: From CS perspective, customers often ask for a timeline + any actions they must take. In this case, none required. Redacted timeline + exec summary usually suffices.
Priya: Ok let's formalize the redaction checklist here so it's in the tracker:
- remove internal hostnames and service IDs
- redact exact CLI sequences and rollback commands
- no staff email/IDs or shift rotations
- aggregate or mask raw logs, show sanitized counts only
Legal: Add: remove specific vendor contract terms or pricing info if present. Also include contact path: CS -> Legal for any escalation.
InfraPM: Noted on the config regressions. This is the 3rd config-related incident this quarter. Can we add a recurring agenda item to triage patterns and propose systemic mitigations by the next reliability review?
Priya: Yes. Action: InfraPM to present pattern analysis at monthly reliability review.
Liam: I'll update the action tracker with these comms items. Proposed owners/dates:
- Liam: post status page update (Legal-approved)  due 2026-10-11 20:00 UTC
- Hannah: public incident summary draft  due 2026-10-14 12:00 UTC
- Legal: deliver redaction checklist + CS guidance  due 2026-10-12 16:00 UTC
- CS-Team: sanitized timeline template and customer-facing Q&A  due 2026-10-14 16:00 UTC
- InfraPM: incident pattern brief for reliability review  due 2026-10-20 10:00 UTC
Priya: One more thing  do we want a short apology line on the public page? Legal, is "We apologize for the disruption" ok?
Legal: Yes, a brief apology is fine. Avoid language that admits negligence or liability. "We apologize for the disruption" is safe.
ops-bot: created follow-up tasks: incident-2026-10-11-02: comms-status-update, comms-public-summary, legal-redaction-checklist, cs-sanitized-timeline, infra-pattern-brief.
CS-Team: We'll triage incoming customer requests and route redaction requests through Legal. Please tag the ticket with `redaction-request` so we can track.
Hannah: For the public summary, I'll include sections: What happened / What we did / Impact / Customer action (none) / Next steps. Short + clear.
Priya: Great. Final call: once Legal approves the redaction checklist, Liam posts status page and replies here with the link. Hannah will attach the public summary to the postmortem.
Liam: Will do and will ping when live. :thumbsup:
Priya: Thanks all. If anything blocks, flag in this thread and set priority to `high` in the tracker.
